eligibility: Male, age ≥ 18 years.
Histologically or cytologically confirmed prostate adenocarcinoma, or no histology but PSA > 100 ng/mL with radiographic metastatic disease at diagnosis.
Metastatic disease on conventional imaging (bone scan, CT, or MRI) or PSMA-PET at ADT initiation. PSA ≥ 2.0 ng/mL before starting ADT (for histologically confirmed cases).
ADT for mCSPC for at least 6 and no more than 12 months (± 3 weeks) at enrollment, and an ARPI (abiraterone, enzalutamide, apalutamide, or darolutamide) for at least 4 months (± 2 weeks).
Prior radiotherapy to the prostate bed and/or metastatic sites allowed, with recovery to grade ≤ 1. Persistent stable ADT toxicities (hot flushes, fatigue) of any grade allowed.
Serum testosterone < 1.7 nmol/L (50 ng/dL) and PSA ≥ 0.2 ng/mL within 28 days of enrollment.
Candidate for docetaxel. ECOG performance status 0-2.

Within 28 days: hemoglobin ≥ 80 g/L, ANC ≥ 1.5 x 10^9/L, platelets ≥ 100 x 10^9/L, total bilirubin ≤ 1.0 x ULN (≤ 2.0 x ULN if Gilbert's), AST/ALT ≤ 1.5 x ULN with alkaline phosphatase ≤ 2.5 x ULN, creatinine clearance ≥ 30 mL/min.
No confirmed PSA progression on ADT (25% rise above nadir and an absolute rise of 2.0 ng/mL, confirmed by a further 25% rise at least 3 weeks later).
No confirmed radiographic or clinical progression since starting ADT (new bone lesions judged to be flare are allowed).
No prior taxane chemotherapy, no grade ≥ 2 peripheral neuropathy, and no severe hypersensitivity to polysorbate 80 formulations.
No unstable angina, symptomatic pericarditis, or MI within 6 months, and no NYHA class III-IV heart failure.
No concurrent anticancer systemic therapy other than ADT and ARPI. No live vaccine within 30 days.
No high-grade neuroendocrine or small cell features (except patients enrolled without histology on the PSA > 100 ng/mL criterion).
Prior or concurrent malignancy allowed if it will not interfere with safety or efficacy assessment.

HIV allowed if on effective antiretroviral therapy with undetectable viral load within 6 months. Chronic HBV must have undetectable viral load on suppressive therapy if indicated. HCV must be treated and cured, or viral load undetectable if on treatment.
